rationale: Monitoring and consolidating infrastructure data are concrete conventional functions, but the method for automated discovery, analytics, and remediation is unspecified. Non-AI is the best-supported forced decision, with unresolved analytics/automation uncertainty.
evidence_spans: monitors your IT environment and consolidates data from existing tools.
It applies automated discovery, monitoring, analytics, and remediation to data across traditional, private, public, multi-cloud and container-based infrastructure.
conflict_response: I do not treat automation as AI, nor do I treat the absence of an AI word as proof. The conventional monitoring/consolidation is clear, while the generic analytics and unspecified discovery/remediation method leave a plausible implementation ambiguity; therefore this remains weak/forced rather than a supported negative.
